reason: TwinFormer applies patching, top-k sparse attention, and GRU aggregation to long-sequence time-series forecasting. The paper reports linear sequence-length complexity and consumer-GPU forecasting, but the target is time-series prediction, not LLM inference or serving; the architectural analogy alone does not establish an LLM lineage match.
title: TwinFormer: A Dual-Level Transformer for Long-Sequence Time-Series Forecasting
